decisions.reason: As a 2023 flagship product on the home page that fits the firm's core dosimetry and instrumentation capabilities, it is too strategically central and still too early in its market test to abandon unless results are clearly poor.

The oncology risk-management software is somewhat less central and easier to prune than the flagship hardware, but in an expanding R&D-intensive firm its software-led option value remains high and the cost of keeping it on the market for further learning is likely modest.
